snippet.title: First Moon of Mercury Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching in 2027: Solve and construct sci-fi puzzle boxes into the First Moon of Mercury, a space station designed to study and deflect dangerous solar flares. Will you trust the right crew members to ensure the safety of humanity or will the saboteurs succeed? 

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4006340/?utm_source=youtube
